notes: First verdict (no earlier file). Checked src/sim/*.ts, test/sim.test.ts (29 pass, none test behaviour), mirofish-notes.md, report.txt step 5, report-static.html, the round-1 brief, the shipped demo (src/report/demo.ts, seed 23) and a 60-seed rule-based sweep. Strong: briefs are self-contained, end in an exact JSON schema and carry no owner costs (rehearsal.ts:419-432). Personas are two-layer Neukölln locals who differ on price, routine and attitude. Each round is a concrete scene. Validation errors are per persona and can be retried. The competitor event raises eats_elsewhere about 40% (157 to 219 over 60 seeds). The caveat and the 'X of 6' counts are never scaled up. MiroFish ideas are borrowed, not its code. Held back: the timeline draws eats_elsewhere and stays_away as 'Not around' (report/rehearsal.ts:49), which hides what the event did. Rule-based text repeats and contradicts itself: duplicate thoughts in 34% of rounds, and untried people say 'Back to my normal order'. Round menus force odd choices: round 4 has no way to stay at the competitor. 'Engaged' counts 'Doesn't notice'. The checklist is chipped 'Your number'. The who-told-whom arrows are inferred, not said. The QA screenshots use seed 42 (nobody tried it, one persona never around), not the shipped demo.
improvements: src/report/rehearsal.ts:49-50: isAway() matches /away|elsewhere/, so eats_elsewhere, goes_elsewhere and stays_away cells are drawn as dashed 'Not around'. In report-static.html, Felix's round-2 'Has lunch somewhere else' shows as 'Not around'. In the shipped seed-23 demo, Sofia and Jonas going to the café opposite in round 3 (the owner event's whole effect) disappears from the grid. Match only action === 'not_around'. Criteria: story across rounds; owner events. Check: a report test where an eats_elsewhere cell keeps its own label and is-neutral class.

src/sim/rehearsal.ts:854 chooseLine and rounds.ts ACTION_TEXT: the rule-based stand-in (what every demo shows) contradicts itself. Over 60 seeds, 81 of 240 lunch rounds have two people thinking the same sentence (seed 23, round 3: Sofia and Jonas both say 'Everyone's talking about the new place'; Bilal and Ines both say 'Back to my normal order'). 50 times, someone who never tried the deal says 'Back to my normal order. Nothing wrong with the deal'. The eats_elsewhere diary says 'Ate at the bakery on the corner' right after a thought about the café opposite. Tomasz always takes lunch to go, yet complains that the window tables are taken. Fixes: when the specific lines are used up, fall back to an unused generic line; gate the back_to_usual lines on 'tried'; take the diary's place from the same condition as the thought; add a takeaway condition. Check: a sim test over seeds 1-60 with no duplicate thought within a round and no 'Back to' line without an earlier try.

src/sim/rounds.ts:258-267 (lunchRounds r3/r4; same pattern in priceRounds): the action menus cannot carry the story's turning points. Round 4 offers only keeps_coming, posts_review, complains or forgets_about_it. So Sofia, who left for the competitor in round 3, must 'keep coming' and is drawn green. In round 3, the only way to try the deal for the first time is 'Comes back for the deal'. Add eats_elsewhere (or 'goes to the new place') to round 4 and tries_deal to round 3. Count keeps_coming toward 'Came back' only after a try. Criterion: story and honest summary. Check: in the seed-23 demo, Sofia's round 4 follows on from her round 3.

Summary labels overclaim. (a) src/report/rehearsal.ts:230 chips 'Check these with real customers' as 'Your number', but the items quote imagined counts ('1 of 2 imagined regulars did'). Use the imagined chip. (b) rounds.ts ACTIONS: price-change 'Doesn't notice' and 'Has forgotten about the change', and lunch 'Keeps coming' with no try, are positive. The uptake chart and the green cells therefore call them 'Engaged with the change' (in the default seed, round 4 jumps to 3 of 5 'engaged' although nobody tried the deal). Split 'still buying' from 'engaged', or label it per template. (c) The 'Came back' funnel counts a regular who says 'Deal or not, this is my café' (Rafael, seed 23). Criterion: honest summary. Check: no non-reaction is counted as engagement in either demo.

src/sim/rehearsal.ts:1204 linksFor infers 'who told whom' from timing alone: Rafael told 'my neighbour', and the arrow points to Sofia. Yet the report says 'Arrows show who passed the news to whom'. Add an optional heardFrom field (a name from the feed) to the reaction JSON in jsonBlock(). Draw links only from it; the rule-based stand-in sets it when heardPos drove the choice. Word of mouth is also thin: over 60 seeds, a lunch run has on average 1.05 public feed items and 0.2 links, so the network view is usually empty. Give round 2 a public option (telling a colleague) for those who tried. Check: average links per run of 1 or more, each traceable to a persona's own words.

qa/checks.ts:250-262: the QA bundle (seed 42, event before round 2) is not the shipped demo (src/report/demo.ts, seed 23, event before round 3). So qa/reports/ui shows a run nobody visits: noticed 1, tried 0, told 0, and Derya is never around in any round. The persona and visual judges are scoring the wrong rehearsal. Build demoReport() from demoState('lunch_offer'). Separately, drawActive() (rehearsal.ts:216) guarantees half the people are around each round, but one person can still be absent all four rounds (6 of 360 in the sweep). Guarantee each persona at least one round where they are around.
